# Get current frame colors
def get_frame_colors(frame_seg):
    nodes = frame_seg['nodes']
    frame_blocks = []
    for n in nodes:
        if n['pixels'] == 16:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            center_r = sum(rows) // len(rows)
            center_c = sum(cols) // len(cols)
            frame_blocks.append({'color': n['color'], 'center': (center_r, center_c)})

        (38, 13), (32, 13), (26, 13)

        for fb in frame_blocks:
            if fb['center'] == ec:

                break
        else:
            colors.append('?')
    return colors
